ar.title: الدجاج بالجبن

steps.n1: تقطع صدور الدجاج شرائح وتشوح في الزيت حتى يصفر لونها ثم ترفع من الحرارة.
steps.n2: تتبل البصلة المبشورة بالملح والفلفل والبهار والخل، وتوضع على الدجاج في الصينية.
steps.n3: يوضع فوق الدجاج الجبن المبشور من أي نوع ويقلب جيدا مع الدجاج.
steps.n4: يصب على الوجه كوب الكريمة ويدخل الفرن حتى النضج ويحمر الوجه.

en.title: Cheese-Topped Chicken

steps.n1: Slice the chicken breasts and sauté them in oil until golden, then remove from heat.
steps.n2: Season the grated onion with salt, pepper, spices, and vinegar, then spread it over the chicken in a baking dish.
steps.n3: Sprinkle any type of shredded cheese over the chicken and mix well with the meat.
steps.n4: Pour the cup of cream over the top and bake in the oven until cooked through and the top is golden brown.

legacySteps: Slice the chicken breasts and sauté them in oil until golden, then remove from heat.
Season the grated onion with salt, pepper, spices, and vinegar, then spread it over the chicken in a baking dish.
Sprinkle any type of shredded cheese over the chicken and mix well with the meat.
Pour the cup of cream over the top and bake in the oven until cooked through and the top is golden brown.
